diagnosis: The Lambda handler caches event.requestContext.authorizer in a module-level variable (globalUserContext) across container invocations. Because AWS Lambda warm containers handle multiple subsequent requests from distinct users, subsequent callers will retain the previous user's authorizer claims and authorization context, exposing private banking transactions.
exploit_request:
GET /accounts/acc_corporate_target_01/transactions HTTP/1.1
Host: banking-api.finlambda.aws.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
